root_causes.description: One API pod is running rendered config inconsistent with the desired release.
Provider retries use an idempotency identity scoped too narrowly or too broadly for the business operation.
An older fulfillment consumer revision is incompatible with the emitted event contract.
Mixed invalidator revisions leave stale customer cache entries.
Insufficient API capacity causes the observed failures.

actions.description: Replace only the API pod proven to have rendered-config drift.
Use one stable provider idempotency key for the same logical order version across retries/deliveries.
Upgrade every fulfillment consumer to the latest revision.
Replace all cache invalidators with the latest revision.
